name: Household pictures
description: Makes a picture or a short video someone asks for through OpenRouter, sends it to the chat, and holds what each person's pictures and videos may cost in a day.

pictureDayDollars.description: The most one person's pictures may cost on this gateway in a day, in dollars.

videoDayDollars.description: The most one person's videos may cost on this gateway in a day, in dollars.
